description: Image Description: The image features a street sign mounted on two metallic poles, positioned in front of a red brick wall. The sign is rectangular, white with a black border, and displays the text "HEGGIES WYND" in bold, black, uppercase letters. Behind the sign, several cars are parked in a lot, including a silver sedan directly behind the sign and a red car to the right. The background includes a Hyundai dealership building with a blue and white sign displaying the Hyundai logo
